name: Sunshine
overview: The Scriptures reveal that God's provision of sunshine is an expression of His impartial goodness, as He causes the sun to rise on both the evil and the good (Matthew 5:45). This natural light metaphorically points to the spiritual illumination found in God's Word, which guides believers like a lamp to their feet and a light to their path (Psalms 119:105). Ultimately, the true source of light and life is the Word made flesh, Jesus Christ, who holds authority over life and death and grants eternal security to His followers (John 1:1; John 10:18, 28). Believers are also indwelt by the Spirit of truth, who enlightens and sustains them beyond what the world can perceive (John 14:17).
